name: Halls
rule: Stone corridors, stairs, and classrooms. Easy going, but every door may be watched.

name: Grounds
rule: Lawns, playing fields, and paths. Easy going on foot.

name: Lake
rule: Open water. Nothing crosses it on foot; the way round follows the shore.

name: Forest
rule: Forest without a path. Tough going on foot, and easy to lose the school behind you.

name: Village Streets
rule: Cobbled streets and lanes between the houses. Easy going on foot.

name: Ruins
rule: Broken walls and old foundations. Tough going, and full of things the school left behind.
